title: Turned Away and Left at Sea

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 回想起当年我在黑胶唱片时代的夜总会里打碟的日子，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每天晚上，你都要带着300件你最珍贵的传家宝去上班，你把DJ台变成了一个美丽的、拥有50年历史的文物的活体快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在，在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重塑者》。

sentences.en: From New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: A few weeks ago, my colleague, Brussels Bureau Chief Matina Steves-Gridniff, received a tip that, if true,
sentences.zh: 几周前，我的同事、布鲁塞尔分社社长玛蒂娜·史蒂夫-格里夫尼夫收到了一条线索，如果属实的话，

sentences.en: would prove that a major European government was carrying out an illegal scheme that deliberately risked the lives of civilians as young as six months old.
sentences.zh: 将证明一个欧洲大国正在实施一项非法的计划，该计划蓄意置年仅六个月大的平民生命于危险之中。

sentences.en: Today, the story of how Matina proved that that tip was true.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将讲述玛蒂娜如何证明这条线索属实的故事。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, June 7th.
sentences.zh: 今天是6月7日，星期三。

sentences.en: Matina, this story starts for you with a tip, right?
sentences.zh: 玛蒂娜，这个故事对你来说是从一个线索开始的，对吧？

sentences.en: So tell us about that tip.
sentences.zh: 那么给我们讲讲那个线索吧。

sentences.en: That's right, Michael.
sentences.zh: 没错，迈克尔。

sentences.en: I'm just sitting in the bureau in Brussels at my desk and I get this email from a man I've never heard of before.
sentences.zh: 我正坐在布鲁塞尔分社的办公桌前，然后我收到了一封来自一个我从未听说过的男人的电子邮件。

sentences.en: And he says that he has shot a very revealing video on the Greek island of Lesbos capturing the Greek authorities, rounding up migrants,
sentences.zh: 他说他在希腊莱斯博斯岛上拍摄了一段非常具有揭露性的视频，捕捉到了希腊当局围捕移民的行为，

sentences.en: and effectively dropping them in a life raft in the middle of the Aegean Sea.
sentences.zh: 并实际上将他们扔在爱琴海正中央的一个救生筏上。

sentences.en: Practically, this means these people can't access the country's asylum system.
sentences.zh: 实际上，这意味着这些人无法使用该国的庇护系统。

sentences.en: They basically never existed as far as formalities are concerned.
sentences.zh: 就法定程序而言，他们基本上从未存在过。

sentences.en: And if what this tipster is claiming he's captured and video is correct, that would be a gross violation of both local law and European Union law,
sentences.zh: 如果这位爆料人声称他拍摄并记录在视频中的内容是正确的，那将是对当地法律、欧盟法律的严重违反，

sentences.en: but also international legislation.
sentences.zh: 同时也违反了国际立法。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So this tipster has delivered a pretty extraordinary and it sounds like explosive claim.
sentences.zh: 所以这位爆料人提供了一个非常非同寻常的、听起来具有爆炸性的说法。

sentences.en: It sounds explosive, but I'm also sort of instinctively quite hesitant to immediately believe him.
sentences.zh: 听起来确实很爆炸，但我也出于本能地对立刻相信他感到相当犹豫。

sentences.en: And the reason is we've heard about this alleged practice by the Greek authorities in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 原因是我们过去曾听说过希腊当局这种所谓的做法。

sentences.en: Multiple news organizations have tried to prove that it's going on, but the evidence hasn't really been there up until that moment.
sentences.zh: 多家新闻机构试图证明这种事正在发生，但在那一刻之前，证据确实并不充分。

sentences.en: So I'm sort of also partly bracing.
sentences.zh: 所以我某种程度上也做好了心理准备。

sentences.en: That it might not be real.
sentences.zh: 这可能不是真的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So tell us what you see once you watch this video.
sentences.zh: 那么给我们讲讲当你观看这段视频时看到了什么。

sentences.en: So the video in total is more than three hours long, but I quickly get to the pertinent parts.
sentences.zh: 这段视频总长度超过三个小时，但我很快就找到了相关的部分。

sentences.en: And immediately I notice it's sort of clearly been taken around midday, exactly like the man who shot it said it was.
sentences.zh: 我立刻注意到它显然是在中午左右拍摄的，完全就像拍摄它的那个男人所说的那样。

sentences.en: And I also recognize the landscape.
sentences.zh: 而且我也认出了这里的风景。

sentences.en: I've been to Lesbos myself.
sentences.zh: 我自己去过莱斯博斯岛。

sentences.en: I've worked there.
sentences.zh: 我在那里工作过。

sentences.en: And it looks familiar.
sentences.zh: 这看起来很眼熟。

sentences.en: And what you see is this unmarked white van, no windows, no plates, nothing, driving down a narrow dirt road toward the coaSt.
sentences.zh: 你看到的是一辆无标志的白色面包车，没有窗户，没有车牌，什么也没有，正沿着一条狭窄的泥土路向海岸开去。

sentences.en: And it stops.
sentences.zh: 然后它停了下来。

sentences.en: And three men who are not wearing uniforms, they're just wearing sort of dark clothes and ski masks.
sentences.zh: 三个没有穿制服的男人走出来，他们只穿着某种深色衣服和滑雪面罩。

sentences.en: You can't see their faces.
sentences.zh: 你看不到他们的脸。

sentences.en: They unlock the back of the van, and then I see a total of 12 people coming out of the van, one by one.
sentences.zh: 他们打开面包车的后门，然后我看到总共有12个人从面包车里一个接一个地走出来。

sentences.en: And some of them, strikingly, are obviously small children.
sentences.zh: 其中一些人引人注目的是，显然是小孩子。

sentences.en: There is even a months-old infant and a lot of women.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有一个几个月大的婴儿和许多妇女。

sentences.en: There's only two men in that group.
sentences.zh: 那群人中只有两个男人。

sentences.en: So all of these things really stand out to me.
sentences.zh: 所以所有这些事情真的让我印象深刻。

sentences.en: Now, the three masked men escort the group down the road to this picturesque little bay that has a wooden pier.
sentences.zh: 现在，这三个蒙面男子护送这群人沿着公路走到这个有木制码头的风景优美的小海湾。

sentences.en: And a larger inflatable engine speedboat is waiting for them there.
sentences.zh: 一艘更大的充气发动机快艇正在那里等候他们。

sentences.en: And one by one, the people who are, at this point I'm realizing, obviously Africans.
sentences.zh: 这些人一个接一个地被送上去，此时我意识到，他们显然是非洲人。

sentences.en: And you can see that some of the women have their heads covered with scarves.
sentences.zh: 你能看到一些妇女的头上裹着头巾。

sentences.en: They're put one by one onto the speedboat, and the speedboat turns around and speeds out at sea.
sentences.zh: 他们被一个接一个地扶上快艇，快艇掉头向大海疾驰而去。

sentences.en: Within two minutes, it approaches a Greek coast guard vessel.
sentences.zh: 不到两分钟，它就接近了一艘希腊海岸警卫队船只。

sentences.en: And that's where I start feeling quite shocked, because this clearly starts to indicate these masked men cooperating with the Greek coast guard.
sentences.zh: 就在那里我开始感到相当震惊，因为这清楚地开始表明这些蒙面男子在与希腊海岸警卫队合作。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This is the Greek government suddenly entering this video.
sentences.zh: 希腊政府突然出现在这段视频中。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's the first time any markings of the state are visible in the video.
sentences.zh: 这是视频中第一次出现国家标志。

sentences.en: And so the speedboat pulls up next to the coast guard vessel that's stopped at sea, and the camera zooms in.
sentences.zh: 因此，快艇停在停在海上的海岸警卫队船只旁，镜头拉近了。

sentences.en: It's a little blurry, but you can still see quite well, one by one, the people being escorted on the coast guard vessel.
sentences.zh: 虽然有点模糊，但你仍然可以看得相当清楚，人们被一个接一个地护送到海岸警卫队的船上。

sentences.en: And you see the coast guard vessel navigating further away from the Lesbos coastline.
sentences.zh: 你看到海岸警卫队的船只驶离莱斯博斯海岸线越来越远。

sentences.en: So, at this point, what you have seen are masked men removing these 12 people from a van with no license plates or markings,
sentences.zh: 所以，此时此刻，你看到的是蒙面男子将这12个人从一辆没有车牌或标志的面包车里拉出来，

sentences.en: putting them on a speedboat, one by one, and then that boat rendezvousing with a Greek government ship,
sentences.zh: 把他们一个接一个地放到一艘快艇上，然后那艘船与一艘希腊政府船只汇合，

sentences.en: which then takes these 12 people, and this is all happening in the middle of the sea.
sentences.zh: 这艘船随后带走了这12个人，这一切都发生在海中央。

sentences.en: And at some point, the coast guard boat, with the 12 migrants on it, stops.
sentences.zh: 在某个时候，载着12名移民的海岸警卫队船只停了下来。

sentences.en: And quite quickly, you see a sort of black, inflatable life raft being dropped off.
sentences.zh: 很快，你就会看到一种黑色的充气救生筏被放下。

sentences.en: The video is blurry.
sentences.zh: 视频很模糊。

sentences.en: The distance is quite big.
sentences.zh: 距离相当远。

sentences.en: But you can still make out the life raft floating behind the coast guard boat.
sentences.zh: 但你仍然可以辨认出漂浮在海岸警卫队船只后面的救生筏。

sentences.en: And soon after, the boat leaves the life raft adrift, turns around, and starts crossing through the bay back toward Lesbos.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，这艘船抛下漂流的救生筏，调转船头，穿过海湾返回莱斯博斯岛。

sentences.en: So, what do you understand to have just happened here?
sentences.zh: 那么，你认为刚才发生了什么？

sentences.en: So, even though I can't see the 12 migrants on this inflatable life raft,
sentences.zh: 因此，尽管我无法在这艘充气救生筏上看到这12名移民，

sentences.en: I believe that they are on that life raft, and they've been left adrift in the middle of the Aegean Sea.
sentences.zh: 但我相信他们就在那艘救生筏上，并且被遗弃在爱琴海的正中央随波逐流。

sentences.en: And sure enough, that belief was quickly reinforced because about an hour and a half further into the video,
sentences.zh: 果不其然，这种信念很快得到了强化，因为在视频大约一个半小时后，

sentences.en: I see two Turkish coast guard vessels approaching the life raft in what seems to be a rescue.
sentences.zh: 我看到两艘土耳其海岸警卫队的船只正在接近救生筏，这似乎是一次救援行动。

sentences.en: The life raft has been left adrift, sort of halfway between the island of Lesbos in Greece and the Turkish coaSt.
sentences.zh: 救生筏被抛弃在希腊莱斯博斯岛和土耳其海岸之间的半空中随波逐流。

sentences.en: And so, it becomes clear that the life raft was left to drift into Turkish territorial waters by the Greek coast guard.
sentences.zh: 因此，很明显，救生筏是被希腊海岸警卫队任其漂入土耳其领海的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Not at all by accident, but in this deliberate effort to keep, as you said, as this tipster suggested to you, these migrants from ever entering the Greek immigration system.
sentences.zh: 绝非偶然，而是正如你所说、正如这位爆料人向你建议的那样，这是蓄意努力阻止这些移民进入希腊移民系统。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And of course, Turkey isn't a member of the European Union.
sentences.zh: 当然，土耳其不是欧盟成员国。

sentences.en: So, now these migrants aren't just out of Greek territory.
sentences.zh: 所以，现在这些移民不仅不在希腊领土上。

sentences.en: They're also out of EU territory.
sentences.zh: 他们也离开了欧盟领土。

sentences.en: So, what are you thinking after you have finished watching this pretty unsettling video?
sentences.zh: 那么，看完这段相当令人不安的视频后，你在想什么？

sentences.en: Well, Michael, I'm thinking that the tipster was right, that what he said he got on video is on video, but we're going to have to do a lot of work to verify it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，迈克尔，我在想爆料人是对的，他在视频里拍到的确实在视频里，但我们要做好多工作来核实它。

sentences.en: And time is of the essence, as this video is only two days old, and we want to move faSt.
sentences.zh: 时间就是一切，因为这段视频只有两天时间，我们想快点行动。

sentences.en: We believe these people, the 12 migrants, must still be somewhere in Turkey.
sentences.zh: 我们相信这些人，这12名移民，一定还在土耳其的某个地方。

sentences.en: And so, we get a reporter that we work with in Turkey to confirm that they are being held in a removal facility,
sentences.zh: 因此，我们让一位我们在土耳其合作的记者去确认他们被关押在一个驱逐设施中，

sentences.en: a sort of prison where migrants are taken before being deported in the coastal city of Izmir.
sentences.zh: 这是一种在沿海城市伊兹密尔将移民在被驱逐出境前带去关押的监狱。

sentences.en: And I fly to Izmir to meet them and interview them.
sentences.zh: 我飞往伊兹密尔去见他们并采访他们。

sentences.en: And what do you find when you get to this prison?
sentences.zh: 当你到达这座监狱时，你发现了什么？

sentences.en: As soon as I see them, I have no doubt on my mind that they are the same people as the people I saw on the video.
sentences.zh: 我一看到他们，就毫不怀疑他们就是我在视频中看到的那群人。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: The composition of the group, their physical attributes, the presence of the small children and the baby, all are consistent with the video.
sentences.zh: 人群的组成、他们的身体特征、小孩子和婴儿的存在，都与视频相符。

sentences.en: But honestly, some of them were still wearing the same clothes more than a week later.
sentences.zh: 但老实说，一个多星期后，他们中的一些人仍然穿着同样的衣服。

sentences.en: I particularly remember being struck by a young woman who was wearing a turquoise hijab and a black and white checked shirt.
sentences.zh: 我特别记得有一个年轻女性给我留下了深刻的印象，她戴着绿松石色的头巾，穿着黑白格子的衬衫。

sentences.en: And she really stood out in the video.
sentences.zh: 她在视频中非常显眼。

sentences.en: And there she was, standing right in front of me in this detention facility in Turkey.
sentences.zh: 而她就站在我面前，在土耳其的这个拘留所里。

sentences.en: First of all, we really appreciate their time.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们非常感谢他们抽出时间。

sentences.en: You can just explain to them that we have this video that shows what happened to them.
sentences.zh: 你可以向他们解释说，我们有这段视频显示了他们身上发生了什么。

sentences.en: And what's the story that these people tell you?
sentences.zh: 这些人告诉你的故事是什么？

sentences.en: Are they all together friends or family together?
sentences.zh: 他们是朋友还是一家人在一起？

sentences.en: So, in order to interview them, we had to patch in translators.
sentences.zh: 为了采访他们，我们不得不连线翻译。

sentences.en: Yeah, I counted.
sentences.zh: 是的，我数过了。

sentences.en: There's a total of nine people in that room.
sentences.zh: 那个房间里总共有九个人。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The first person, the lady with the turquoise-colored hijab, who's grabbing her face now.
sentences.zh: 第一个人，那个戴着绿松石色头巾的女士，现在正抓着她的脸。

sentences.en: Her name is Suleika.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫苏莱卡。

sentences.en: She's the mother of seven of those kids.
sentences.zh: 她是其中七个孩子的母亲。

sentences.en: One of the first things we were able to establish is that they weren't, in fact, all family members.
sentences.zh: 我们能够确定的第一件事是，事实上他们并不全是家庭成员。

sentences.en: But they do all come from the same part of the world.
sentences.zh: 但他们确实都来自世界的同一地区。

sentences.en: They come from the Horn of Africa.
sentences.zh: 他们来自非洲之角。

sentences.en: There is an Ethiopian, an Eritrean, and two mothers with their children, and they come from Somalia.
sentences.zh: 有一个埃塞俄比亚人、一个厄立特里亚人，还有两位带着孩子的母亲，他们来自索马里。

sentences.en: They can't return to Somalia due to the security situation back home, is what they were saying.
sentences.zh: 他们说，由于家乡的安全局势，他们无法返回索马里。

sentences.en: And really, their stories are the stories of that region and just how badly security, safety have collapsed over the last few years.
sentences.zh: 真的，他们的故事就是那个地区的故事，也就是过去几年安全状况崩溃得多么严重的故事。

sentences.en: For example, the youngest mother, Naima, she comes from a southern part of Somalia that is held entirely by a terrorist group called Al-Shabaab.
sentences.zh: 例如，最年轻的母亲奈玛，她来自索马里南部的一个完全由一个名为“青年党”的恐怖组织控制的地区。

sentences.en: She's fleeing Somalia with her six-month-old baby boy, Awale.
sentences.zh: 她带着六个月大的男婴阿瓦莱逃离索马里。

sentences.en: And every story that we hear is somehow related to the hardship these people are facing in their home countries and the very complex,
sentences.zh: 我们听到的每一个故事都多多少少与这些人祖国面临的苦难以及他们前往欧洲时所必须经历的非常复杂的、

sentences.en: brutal ways that they've had to make their migration toward Europe.
sentences.zh: 残酷的方式有关。

sentences.en: And what did these migrants tell you about how they all ended up in that white, unmarked van?
sentences.zh: 这些移民对你说了些什么，关于他们是如何最终落入那辆无标志的白色面包车的？

sentences.en: So let's start by talking about what happened last week.
sentences.zh: 让我们先从上周发生的事情开始谈起。

sentences.en: Well, they say that they had arrived on the Greek island of Lesbos after paying smugglers to get there in two separate groups.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们说他们在分两批向走私者支付了费用后抵达了希腊莱斯博斯岛。

sentences.en: They hadn't met before being locked into the back of that van.
sentences.zh: 在被锁进那辆面包车的后备箱之前，他们从未见过面。

sentences.en: They say that they entered Greece.
sentences.zh: 他们说他们进入了希腊。

sentences.en: They arrived on the island during nightfall.
sentences.zh: 他们在夜幕降临的时候抵达了这个岛屿。

sentences.en: It was nighttime.
sentences.zh: 那是夜间。

sentences.en: And after arriving on Lesbos, it was the middle of the night.
sentences.zh: 抵达莱斯博斯岛后，已经是半夜了。

sentences.en: It was dark.
sentences.zh: 天很黑。

sentences.en: So they sheltered in the woods that night.
sentences.zh: 所以他们那天晚上在树林里避难。

sentences.en: And as a result, while they were taking shelter in those woods, that's when the men with the masks came across them.
sentences.zh: 结果，就在他们在那些树林里避难时，戴着面具的男人遇到了他们。

sentences.en: They sought refuge in the brush close to the coastline.
sentences.zh: 他们在靠近海岸线的灌木丛中寻求庇护。

sentences.en: And they were confronted by masked men.
sentences.zh: 他们遇到了蒙面男子。

sentences.en: And the women and children, in fact, were told by these men that they were rescue workers, that they worked for the famous medical charity Doctors Without Borders.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这些男子对妇女和儿童说他们是救援人员，他们为著名的医疗慈善机构“无国界医生”工作。

sentences.en: The masked men introduced themselves as doctors, claiming to be doctors and medical staff to assist them.
sentences.zh: 蒙面男子自称是医生，声称是医生和医务人员来协助他们。

sentences.en: It quickly became clear that was a total lie.
sentences.zh: 很快就很明显，这完全是个谎言。

sentences.en: When the men saw them, all the women, where their hijabs were ripped off of their heads,
sentences.zh: 当这些男人看到他们时，所有的妇女头上的头巾都被扯掉了，

sentences.en: they were stripped down, their pants were forcibly taken off of them, including the children.
sentences.zh: 她们被剥光了衣服，裤子被强行脱掉，包括小孩子们。

sentences.en: And their money and any valuables they had were also taken away by the men.
sentences.zh: 他们身上的钱和任何贵重物品也被这些男人拿走了。

sentences.en: The masked men took their money, their mobile phones, any documents they had on them, rounded them up.
sentences.zh: 蒙面男子拿走了他们的钱、手机、身上携带的任何文件，并将他们围捕起来。

sentences.en: And a little later, the two young men who had been apprehended in a separate operation by the masked men were also thrown into that white van with the women and the children.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，在另一次行动中被蒙面男子抓获的两名年轻男子也被扔进那辆装有妇女和儿童的白色面包车里。

sentences.en: And that's where the testimony from the migrants leads us up to what we started seeing on the video.
sentences.zh: 这就是移民的证词引导我们了解我们在视频中开始看到的内容。

sentences.en: I'm just going to take a pause now because I think we need to let these people go.
sentences.zh: 我现在要暂停一下，因为我认为我们需要放这些人走了。

sentences.en: The kids are tired and they're very tired.
sentences.zh: 孩子们累了，他们非常累。

sentences.en: Listen, if you can tell them, first of all, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 听着，如果你能告诉他们，首先，非常感谢。

sentences.en: And also that I'm really sorry about what happened to them.
sentences.zh: 还有，对于他们身上发生的事情，我真的很抱歉。

sentences.en: So at this point, Matina, what's your level of confidence that this is exactly what this tipster, out of the blue emails you about, says it is?
sentences.zh: 所以，玛蒂娜，在这一点上，你有多大把握这就是那个爆料人通过突如其来的电子邮件向你反映的情况？

sentences.en: At this point, Michael, I'm 100 percent sure.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，此时此刻，我百分之百确定。

sentences.en: And I'm also 100 percent sure that that's not how the European Union asylum system is supposed to work.
sentences.zh: 我也百分之百确定这不是欧盟庇护系统应该运作的方式。

sentences.en: I feel very confident that we have the most solid evidence ever presented that the Greek authorities are involved in a crime.
sentences.zh: 我非常有信心，我们掌握了有史以来提出的最确凿的证据，证明希腊当局参与了一起犯罪。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 430 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 在太空度过的七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想要探索下一颗恒星之外的世界。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千个消费产品指南。

sentences.en: Today, I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天，我正在测试七张床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能每年都是联赛中最好的队伍。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天使用不同的起始单词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢一个平底锅就能做好的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，助您理解世界，过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，即可在 nytimes.com 斜杠 subscribe 享受优惠。

sentences.en: Matina, why would Greece do this to migrants that enter its country?
sentences.zh: 玛蒂娜，希腊为什么要这样对待进入其境内的移民？

sentences.en: Why would it so brazenly violate the law, but above all, treat people like this, risking their lives to avoid having them enter Greece's immigration system as asylum seekers?
sentences.zh: 它为什么会如此明目张胆地违法，最重要的是，如此对待人类，冒着他们的生命危险，只为避免让他们作为难民进入希腊的移民系统？

sentences.en: Well, Michael, there's a long, nearly decade-old story as to how we get to the point of the Greek authorities treating migrants like this.
sentences.zh: 嗯，迈克尔，这是一个历时近十年的漫长故事，解释了我们是如何走到希腊当局这样对待移民这一步的。

sentences.en: Perhaps you'll remember that around 2015, 2016, because of the huge displacement caused by the civil war in Syria, more than one million Syrians mainly, but also Iraqis,
sentences.zh: 也许你还记得，大约在2015年、2016年，由于叙利亚内战造成的大规模流离失所，主要是一百万以上的叙利亚人，还有伊拉克人，

sentences.en: tried to make their way to Europe to seek refuge, fleeing those conflicts.
sentences.zh: 为了逃离这些冲突，试图前往欧洲寻求避难。

sentences.en: I was there myself in 2015 on the Greek island of Lesbos.
sentences.zh: 2015年我本人就在希腊的莱斯沃斯岛。

sentences.en: As thousands and thousands of refugees arrived on a daily basis, Greece was just the first stop for these people trying to get to Europe and get to safety.
sentences.zh: 随着成千上万的难民每天不断涌现，希腊只是这些试图抵达欧洲并获得安全的人的第一站。

sentences.en: And by all accounts, Greeks at that time were incredibly generous.
sentences.zh: 据各方反映，当时的希腊人极其慷慨。

sentences.en: The Greek coast guard, the very same coast guard we saw on that vessel ditching people in the Aegean Sea,
sentences.zh: 希腊海岸警卫队，也就是我们在那艘船上看到把人扔进爱琴海的同一支海岸警卫队，

sentences.en: that coast guard was rescuing hundreds of people every day and helping them along their way.
sentences.zh: 那支海岸警卫队曾经每天营救数百人并护送他们前行。

sentences.en: So it was a completely different picture.
sentences.zh: 所以当时完全是另一幅画面。

sentences.en: I mean, the residents of the Greek islands of the Aegean that received those refugees were even put up for a Nobel Peace Prize for their generosity.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，接待这些难民的爱琴海希腊岛屿居民甚至因他们的慷慨而被提名诺贝尔和平奖。

sentences.en: The media documented their extraordinary generosity and reaction to helping people in need.
sentences.zh: 媒体记录了他们非凡的慷慨以及对帮助困难人群的反应。

sentences.en: So what changed?
sentences.zh: 那么是什么改变了？

sentences.en: Well, Michael, at that time, famously, then-German Chancellor Angela Merkel said, we will manage.
sentences.zh: 嗯，迈克尔，当时著名的时任德国总理安格拉·默克尔说，我们能行。

sentences.en: And she opened her country's borders to receive more than one million Syrian and Iraqi refugees in the space of months.
sentences.zh: 她在几个月内敞开国家大门，接收了一百万以上的叙利亚和伊拉克难民。

sentences.en: Many Germans are rolling out a cheering red carpet welcome for refugees.
sentences.zh: 许多德国人正以热烈的红地毯欢迎仪式迎接难民。

sentences.en: For everyone here.
sentences.zh: 为了这里的每一个人。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Lady Merkel.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，默克尔女士。

sentences.en: Thank you so much, Deutschland.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢，德国。

sentences.en: But that generosity dried up quickly and abruptly.
sentences.zh: 但这种慷慨迅速而急剧地消退了。

sentences.en: It is not just the Bavarian weather that is growing icy.
sentences.zh: 变得冰冷的不仅仅是巴伐利亚的天气。

sentences.en: The welcome now at Germany's southern border is much colder.
sentences.zh: 现在德国南部边境的欢迎态度要冷淡得多。

sentences.en: Germany has reintroduced Czechs at its border with Austria in an attempt to better control the huge number of migrants and refugees arriving.
sentences.zh: 为了更好地控制大量涌入的难民和移民，德国已在其与奥地利的边境重新实施了检查。

sentences.en: Germany closed its borders, and so did most of the other European Union countries.
sentences.zh: 德国关闭了边境，欧盟的大多数其他国家也这样做。

sentences.en: Austria is a small country.
sentences.zh: 奥地利是个小国。

sentences.en: You know, beyond this, this country will be full, full, full very soon.
sentences.zh: 你知道，除此之外，这个国家很快就会满员了，满员了，满员了。

sentences.en: But refugees kept coming, and many of them ended up in Greece, stuck on those islands for months and months.
sentences.zh: 但难民源源不断地到来，其中许多人最终滞留在希腊，在那些岛上困了几个月又几个月。

sentences.en: So they languished in Greece, in many cases in terrible conditions on the island of Lesbos and other neighboring islands.
sentences.zh: 因此他们在希腊苦苦挣扎，在许多情况下处于莱斯沃斯岛及其他邻近岛屿的糟糕环境中。

sentences.en: It's conditions that you wouldn't see in some of the poorest countries in the world.
sentences.zh: 这是你在世界上某些最贫穷国家都看不到的状况。

sentences.en: It is terrible, really terrible, because we didn't do anything.
sentences.zh: 这太糟糕了，真的很糟糕，因为我们什么也没做。

sentences.en: We didn't respect.
sentences.zh: 我们没有得到尊重。

sentences.en: We leave our country.
sentences.zh: 我们离开了我们的国家。

sentences.en: I live here in a tent without any accommodation.
sentences.zh: 我住在这里的帐篷里，没有任何住所。

sentences.en: We are human.
sentences.zh: 我们是人。

sentences.en: It was really very confronting for the small communities on the Greek islands, such as the island of Lesbos, that were hosting often dozens of thousands of people in their midSt.
sentences.zh: 对于希腊岛屿（如莱斯沃斯岛）这样经常在其中心容纳成千上万人的小社区来说，这确实非常令人难以面对。

sentences.en: So what's the reaction from these Greek people, especially on these islands, to the fact that Greece is no longer a stop on the way to the rest of Europe for these migrants,
sentences.zh: 那么这些希腊人，尤其是这些岛屿上的人，对于希腊不再是这些移民前往欧洲其他地方的中转站这一事实有何反应，

sentences.en: but now kind of a permanent destination, an end of the journey rather than a beginning?
sentences.zh: 而是现在变成了一个永久的目的地，是旅程的终点而不是起点？

sentences.en: The squalor of the conditions just made the local communities feel that asylum seekers should not be in Greece at all.
sentences.zh: 恶劣的条件让当地社区觉得寻求庇护者根本不应该留在希腊。

sentences.en: And that informed government policy.
sentences.zh: 这决定了政府的政策。

sentences.en: Explain that.
sentences.zh: 请解释一下。

sentences.en: Well, the Greek government realized that even though the huge numbers of particularly Syrian refugees that we had seen around 2015 and 2016,
sentences.zh: 嗯，希腊政府意识到，尽管我们在2015年和2016年前后看到的特别是叙利亚难民数量巨大，

sentences.en: even though the numbers of asylum seekers arriving in Greece later were much, much smaller, just a fraction, in fact,
sentences.zh: 尽管后来到达希腊的寻求庇护者数量要少得多，实际上只是一小部分，

sentences.en: that was still too many because the local community, Greek voters, didn't want these people there.
sentences.zh: 那依然太多了，因为当地社区和希腊选民不希望这些人待在那里。

sentences.en: And so they developed a much tougher, tougher line toward asylum seekers.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们对寻求庇护者采取了更加强硬的路线。

sentences.en: And part of that tougher line was a harsher approach to them right at the borders.
sentences.zh: 作为这条强硬路线的一部分，他们直接在边境采取了更严厉的做法。

sentences.en: So that they never even enter the Greek asylum system.
sentences.zh: 好让这些人甚至无法进入希腊的庇护系统。

sentences.en: Effectively, what we saw in our video and through our investigation was the most extreme version of that policy,
sentences.zh: 实际上，我们在视频中和调查中看到的是该政策最极端的版本，

sentences.en: that these people were sent back so that it was like they were never even there.
sentences.zh: 这些人被遣返，就好像他们从来没有去过那里一样。

sentences.en: But, you know, what obligation in the eyes of the Greek government and the Greek people does the larger European Union have here?
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，在希腊政府和希腊人民看来，欧盟其他成员国在这里承担什么义务？

sentences.en: Because what you have just laid out is the story of a system that in the beginning, back in 2015,
sentences.zh: 因为你刚才阐述的是一个系统，在最初的2015年，

sentences.en: absorbed all these migrants in a somewhat proportional way.
sentences.zh: 以某种相对成比例的方式吸收了所有这些移民。

sentences.en: And now is asking Greece to shoulder a disproportionate amount of it.
sentences.zh: 而现在却要求希腊承担不成比例的份额。

sentences.en: So what should the EU be doing?
sentences.zh: 那么欧盟应该做什么？

sentences.en: Well, the responsibility that the European Union has toward Greece and the responsibility that Greece has toward the European Union
sentences.zh: 嗯，欧盟对希腊的责任以及希腊对欧盟的责任

sentences.en: has been hotly debated in Europe for many, many years.
sentences.zh: 多年来在欧洲一直是激烈争论的话题。

sentences.en: Certainly, the Greek authorities believe that the European Union should create a much faster and firmer way
sentences.zh: 当然，希腊当局认为欧盟应该建立一种更快、更坚决的方式

sentences.en: to determine whether migrants are entitled to asylum or not and should remove them from Greek territory and distribute them in the rest of the European Union nearly instantly.
sentences.zh: 来确定移民是否有权获得庇护，并应将他们从希腊领土移走，几乎是立即分流到欧盟的其他地方。

sentences.en: The European Union thinks that Greece should do a much better job at welcoming, processing and hosting asylum seekers.
sentences.zh: 欧盟认为希腊应该在欢迎、处理和接待寻求庇护者方面做得更好。

sentences.en: And in fact, has put billions behind that demand.
sentences.zh: 事实上，它为此投入了数十亿美元。

sentences.en: It has paid for Greece to build better facilities where people can stay while their asylum requests are being processed.
sentences.zh: 它出资帮助希腊建造更好的设施，以便人们在庇护申请处理期间居住。

sentences.en: It has helped the Greek government financially and with personnel in guarding its borders.
sentences.zh: 它在资金和人员上协助希腊政府守卫边境。

sentences.en: In fact, the Coast Guard vessel that we saw in our video in our investigation effectively violating Greek and European law
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们在视频和调查中看到的那个实际上违反了希腊和欧洲法律的海岸警卫队船只，

sentences.en: was paid for 75% by European Union funds as part of that effort to support Greece.
sentences.zh: 作为支持希腊努力的一部分，其75%的资金由欧盟提供。

sentences.en: So there's a standoff here.
sentences.zh: 所以这里存在一场对峙。

sentences.en: And in the face of this ongoing flow of migrants, it sounds like Greece's answer is to take this rather extreme step of forcibly putting these migrants out to sea.
sentences.zh: 面对源源不断的移民潮，听起来希腊的对策是采取这种相当极端的做法，将这些移民强行驱逐到海上。

sentences.en: That's right, Michael, there is a standoff, but there's also a tacit agreement between the European Union and Greece.
sentences.zh: 没错，迈克尔，确实存在对峙，但欧盟与希腊之间也存在默契。

sentences.en: In a way, Greece is sort of doing Europe's dirty business.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，希腊有点像在替欧洲干脏活。

sentences.en: And as long as they don't get caught, the European Union has been until now happy to sort of let it carry on.
sentences.zh: 只要不被抓到，欧盟直到现在都乐于任由其继续下去。

sentences.en: In fact, the European Union and the European Commission in Brussels, they know Greece has been treating migrants harshly and potentially illegally.
sentences.zh: 事实上，欧盟和布鲁塞尔的欧盟委员会知道希腊对待移民手段严厉且可能违法。

sentences.en: There have been many lawsuits in the European Court of Human Rights.
sentences.zh: 欧洲人权法院有很多诉讼。

sentences.en: There have been news articles.
sentences.zh: 有很多新闻文章。

sentences.en: There have been migrant testimonies.
sentences.zh: 有很多移民证词。

sentences.en: But until now, it has chosen not to punish Greece.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，它选择不惩罚希腊。

sentences.en: And the reason for that is that Greece is necessary.
sentences.zh: 原因在于希腊是必不可少的。

sentences.en: It's important for Europe's migration management.
sentences.zh: 它对欧洲的移民管理很重要。

sentences.en: But this incident that we managed to investigate and bring to light may just have been that one step too far.
sentences.zh: 但我们设法调查并曝光的这起事件可能恰恰过分了一点。

sentences.en: You know, Matina, we're talking here about Greece and we're talking about the EU and the way that they're treating these migrants.
sentences.zh: 你知道，玛蒂娜，我们在这里讨论希腊，讨论欧盟以及他们对待这些移民的方式。

sentences.en: What we're really talking about is asylum and the nature of asylum.
sentences.zh: 我们真正讨论的是庇护以及庇护的本质。

sentences.en: And it strikes me that the United States has been deliberately restricting asylum now for several years,
sentences.zh: 给我的印象是，美国现在已经蓄意限制庇护好几年了，

sentences.en: starting with Title 42 during the COVID emergency and now with a program to replace it that will make seeking asylum harder and harder.
sentences.zh: 从新冠紧急情况下的第42条开始，现在又有一个取代它的计划，将使寻求庇护变得越来越难。

sentences.en: That's clearly what Greece and the EU seem to be wanting to do as well, make it harder to seek asylum.
sentences.zh: 这显然也是希腊和欧盟似乎想要做的，让寻求庇护变得更难。

sentences.en: So what do you make of that fact that this is going on across these different continents at the same time?
sentences.zh: 那么，对于这些不同大陆同时发生这种情况，你有什么看法？

sentences.en: Michael, I think you've hit the nail on the head, really.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，我觉得你真的切中要害了。

sentences.en: I mean, I think across the sort of so-called Western world, the developed world, we are seeing that countries are adopting more and more restrictive migration and refugee policies.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为在所谓的西方世界、发达世界，我们看到各国正在采取越来越具限制性的移民和难民政策。

sentences.en: And that includes the United States, it includes the European Union, but also Australia, Britain,
sentences.zh: 这包括美国，包括欧盟，还有澳大利亚、英国，

sentences.en: all of these places are simply getting tougher on migration more or less at the same time.
sentences.zh: 所有这些地方都在大致同一时间对移民采取更强硬的态度。

sentences.en: And to be sure, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 可以肯定的是，美国

sentences.en: still takes in thousands of refugees.
sentences.zh: 仍然接纳数千名难民。

sentences.en: The European Union has taken in millions of Ukrainians fleeing war at its doorstep.
sentences.zh: 欧盟已经接纳了数百万逃离家门口战争的乌克兰人。

sentences.en: But in other ways, we are seeing an erosion of the right to asylum.
sentences.zh: 但在其他方面，我们正看到庇护权的侵蚀。

sentences.en: And that just sort of looks different country to country, depending on each country's particularities and conditions.
sentences.zh: 这在不同国家看起来有所不同，取决于每个国家的独特性和条件。

sentences.en: And I think that taking a couple of steps back, those policies appear coordinated, reflect a few trends we've seen across the developed world in the last 10 years.
sentences.zh: 我认为退一步来看，这些政策似乎是协调一致的，反映了过去十年我们在整个发达世界看到的几种趋势。

sentences.en: We have seen the rise of nativist politics.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了本土主义政治的兴起。

sentences.en: But we've also seen the fortunes of people in the developed world deteriorate in some cases through inflation and the cost of living.
sentences.zh: 但我们也看到发达世界人们的财富在某些情况下通过通货膨胀和生活成本而恶化。

sentences.en: The means that the people who live in the rich world are feeling like their standards of living are dropping.
sentences.zh: 这意味着生活在富裕世界的人们觉得他们的生活水平正在下降。

sentences.en: And that's made that generosity of previous decades erode.
sentences.zh: 这使得前几十年那种慷慨消磨殆尽。

sentences.en: At the same time, though, in the poorer parts of the world, in so many regions, we are seeing more conflict and more hardship.
sentences.zh: 然而与此同时，在世界的较贫困地区，在许多地区，我们看到更多的冲突和更多的苦难。

sentences.en: And often, in fact, the West has had a hand in that.
sentences.zh: 而且通常事实上，西方也插手其中。

sentences.en: This creates a recipe for disaster, a recipe for abuse.
sentences.zh: 这为灾难埋下了祸根，为虐待埋下了祸根。

sentences.en: And I guess where this story leaves me is wondering whether what we documented, what we uncovered in the case of Greece, is it going to prove to be a step too far?
sentences.zh: 我想这个故事给我的感受是，我们在希腊记录的、我们发现的情况，最终会被证明是过分了一步吗？

sentences.en: Is Greece going to be punished for this kind of behavior?
sentences.zh: 希腊会因为这种行为而受到惩罚吗？

sentences.en: Or is it going to be eventually met with a shrug and will basically become broader accepted policy?
sentences.zh: 还是最终会被耸耸肩敷衍过去，并基本上演变成更广泛接受的政策？

sentences.en: A kind of new norm in avoiding asylum might be literally shipping people out to sea so that they can never seek asylum.
sentences.zh: 避免庇护的一种新常态可能是字面意义上把人运送到海上去，这样他们就永远无法寻求庇护。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: But, Tita, before we conclude, I want to understand what is likely to become of those 12 people that you met in that Turkish detention center.
sentences.zh: 但是，蒂塔，在我们结束之前，我想了解你在那个土耳其拘留中心遇到的那12个人可能会有什么结局。

sentences.en: They came to Greece because they wanted to get asylum within the European Union, but they never were allowed to apply.
sentences.zh: 他们来到希腊是因为他们想在欧盟境内获得庇护，但他们从未被允许申请。

sentences.en: So what do we think is going to happen to them now?
sentences.zh: 那么我们认为他们现在会怎么样？

sentences.en: Do they have any chance of getting asylum anywhere?
sentences.zh: 他们有任何机会在任何地方获得庇护吗？

sentences.en: Well, Michael, at least two of them have now been released from the detention facility in Izmir.
sentences.zh: 嗯，迈克尔，他们当中至少有两人现在已经从伊兹密尔的拘留设施中释放了。

sentences.en: The Somali women and children may still be in detention.
sentences.zh: 索马里妇女和儿童可能仍被拘留。

sentences.en: We're not sure.
sentences.zh: 我们不确定。

sentences.en: But none of them has been able to apply for asylum in the European Union, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然，他们中没有人能够在欧盟申请庇护。

sentences.en: One young man who was on that boat, Mahdi, who's from Ethiopia,
sentences.zh: 船上的一个年轻人马赫迪，他是埃塞俄比亚人，

sentences.en: I've been in touch with him since our investigation was published.
sentences.zh: 自我们的调查发表以来，我一直与他保持联系。

sentences.en: He's been released from detention, and he's now seriously considering applying for asylum in Turkey.
sentences.zh: 他已从拘留所释放，现在正认真考虑在土耳其申请庇护。

sentences.en: And despite the different outcomes for each of these people,
sentences.zh: 尽管这些人的结局各不相同，

sentences.en: the one thing that seemed to be something they agreed on was that they had been devastated by their experience of trying to get to Greece.
sentences.zh: 似乎有一点是他们意见一致的，那就是他们去希腊的经历让他们深受打击。

sentences.en: Mahdi told me he regretted even trying to go to Greece to get asylum.
sentences.zh: 马赫迪告诉我，他甚至后悔试图去希腊寻求庇护。

sentences.en: Which, if we're being honest, may be exactly what Greece wants him to feel.
sentences.zh: 说实话，这可能正是希腊希望他感受到的。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: Well, Matina, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，玛蒂娜，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Michael.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，迈克尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜洛。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我编写《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一“连线”，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天创作游戏“拼写蜜蜂”和“字母箱”。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的现象。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由真人制作的，就像你刚才听到的人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com 斜杠 games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的内容。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, a critical dam along the front line of Ukraine's war with Russia was destroyed, triggering massive flooding that put tens of thousands of people at risk.
sentences.zh: 周二，乌克兰与俄罗斯战争前线的一座关键水坝被毁，引发了大规模洪水，使数万人面临危险。

sentences.en: Ukraine and Russia each accused the other of blowing up the dam along the Dnipro River in southern Ukraine, which held back a body of water the size of the Great Salt Lake in Utah.
sentences.zh: 乌克兰和俄罗斯互相指责对方炸毁了位于乌克兰南部第聂伯河上的水坝，该水坝拦截的水量相当于犹他州的大盐湖。

sentences.en: We have all seen the tragic images coming out today of the monumental humanitarian, economic, and ecological catastrophe in the Kherson region of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 我们都看到了今天从乌克兰赫尔松地区传来的悲惨画面，那里发生了巨大的难民、经济和生态灾难。

sentences.en: During a news conference in New York, the Secretary General of the United Nations said that no matter what caused the disaster, the Kremlin was ultimately responsible.
sentences.zh: 联合国秘书长在纽约举行的新闻发布会上表示，无论这场灾难是由什么原因引起的，克里姆林宫都要承担最终责任。

sentences.en: One thing is clear.
sentences.zh: 有一点很清楚。

sentences.en: This is another devastating consequence of the Russian invasion of Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 这是俄罗斯入侵乌克兰造成的又一个毁灭性后果。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Rochelle Bonja, Shannon Lynn, and Diana Nguyen, with help from Michael Simon-Johnson.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由罗谢尔·邦贾、香农·林恩和戴安娜·阮制作，迈克尔·西蒙-约翰逊提供了帮助。

sentences.en: It was edited by MJ Davis-Lynn, contains original music by Marian Lozano,
sentences.zh: 节目由MJ·戴维斯-林恩剪辑，包含玛丽安·洛扎诺的原创音乐，

sentences.en: Dan Powell, and Rowan Emisto, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 丹·鲍威尔和罗温·埃米斯托，由克里斯·伍德进行混音工程。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsberg of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由 Wonderly 的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯伯格创作。

sentences.en: Special thanks to Fayyad Moula and Mohamed Gubba Bey.
sentences.zh: 特别感谢法亚德·穆拉和穆罕默德·古巴·贝.

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Balmorrow.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔莫罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们将为假期接待客人做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让您的客宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们对光线敏感吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝断片才能睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线条件？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有对什么过敏或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢听播客的任何地方搜索《Wirecutter秀》。
